title: Spiced Red Lentil Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, celery, and minced garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Stir in rinsed lentils, tomato paste, salt, and water to cover, simmer 22 minutes until soft, and finish with lemon juice.

title: Creamy Cheddar Potato Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion and carrot in unsalted butter for 6 minutes. Add cubed potato, whole milk, and salt, simmer 20 minutes until tender, mash lightly, and stir in cheddar cheese until melted.

title: Roasted Tomato Garlic Soup
instructions: Toss halved tomato, yellow onion, and whole garlic cloves with olive oil and salt, then roast at 200 C for 25 minutes. Blend with tomato paste and warm through for 5 minutes.

title: Creamy Broccoli Cheddar Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion and carrot in unsalted butter for 5 minutes. Add broccoli florets, whole milk, and salt, simmer 12 minutes until tender, and stir in cheddar cheese until smooth.

title: Chicken Noodle and Vegetable Soup
instructions: Saute diced chicken breast, carrot, celery, and yellow onion in olive oil for 7 minutes. Add water and salt, simmer 18 minutes, stir in broken spaghetti, and cook 8 minutes until tender.

title: Hearty Black Bean and Corn Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, red bell pepper, and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Stir in black beans, sweet corn, diced tomato, and salt, then simmer 18 minutes.

title: Cream of Mushroom Soup
instructions: Slice mushrooms and saute with diced yellow onion and minced garlic in unsalted butter for 8 minutes. Whisk in all-purpose flour for 1 minute, slowly add whole milk and salt, and simmer 12 minutes until thickened.

title: Sweet Potato and Ginger Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion and minced garlic in coconut oil for 5 minutes. Add cubed sweet potato, water, and salt, simmer 20 minutes until soft, blend until smooth, and finish with lemon juice.

title: Spinach and Egg Drop Soup
instructions: Bring salted water with soy sauce and minced garlic to a gentle simmer. Stir in fresh spinach until wilted, slowly drizzle in beaten whole egg while stirring gently, and cook 2 minutes until ribbons set.

title: Tuscan White Bean and Kale Soup
instructions: Saute chopped kale, diced yellow onion, carrot, and minced garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Add chickpeas, diced tomato, and salt, simmer 20 minutes, and finish with lemon juice.

title: Cauliflower and Garlic Soup
instructions: Saute cauliflower florets, diced yellow onion, and minced garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Add water and salt, simmer 16 minutes until tender, and blend until creamy.

title: Chicken and Brown Rice Soup
instructions: Saute diced chicken breast, carrot, celery, and yellow onion in olive oil for 7 minutes. Stir in rinsed brown rice, water, and salt, cover, and simmer 30 minutes until rice and chicken are tender.

title: Tomato and Zucchini Vegetable Soup
instructions: Saute diced zucchini, yellow onion, carrot, and minced garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Add chopped tomato, tomato paste, water, and salt, then simmer 16 minutes.

title: Creamy Potato and Leek-Style Onion Soup
instructions: Cook sliced yellow onion slowly in unsalted butter for 10 minutes until soft and sweet. Add cubed potato, whole milk, and salt, simmer 18 minutes until tender, and mash or blend lightly.

title: Tofu and Vegetable Soy Broth Soup
instructions: Bring water with soy sauce, minced garlic, and salt to a simmer. Add cubed tofu, broccoli florets, and sliced mushrooms, cooking 10 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.

title: Kidney Bean and Tomato Minestrone Style Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, celery, and garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Stir in kidney beans, diced tomato, tomato paste, broken spaghetti, and salt, then simmer 18 minutes until pasta is cooked.

title: Creamy Spinach and Parmesan Soup
instructions: Saute minced garlic and diced yellow onion in unsalted butter for 5 minutes. Add whole milk, fresh spinach, and salt, simmer 8 minutes until spinach wilts, and stir in grated parmesan cheese.

title: Green Pea and Sweet Corn Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Add green peas, sweet corn, water, and salt, simmer 12 minutes, and blend half for a creamy texture.

title: Shredded Chicken and Potato Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, and celery in olive oil for 6 minutes. Add cubed potato, diced chicken breast, water, and salt, simmer 20 minutes until potatoes and chicken are cooked, and shred chicken before serving.

title: Lemon Lentil and Spinach Soup
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Stir in lentils, water, and salt, simmer 20 minutes until tender, then stir in fresh spinach and lemon juice until wilted.

title: Dark Chocolate Mousse
instructions: Melt dark chocolate and unsalted butter over low heat and let cool slightly. Whip heavy cream with granulated sugar until soft peaks form, gently fold in the chocolate mixture, and chill at least 1 hour before serving.

title: Baked Cinnamon Apples
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 C. Core and halve apple, brush with melted unsalted butter, drizzle with brown sugar and honey, and bake 25 to 30 minutes until tender and caramelized.

title: Chocolate Chip Oat Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C. Cream unsalted butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar, beat in whole egg, and mix in all-purpose flour, rolled oats, salt, and chopped dark chocolate. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until golden edges set.

title: Strawberry Cream Fool
instructions: Mash half the strawberries with granulated sugar and lemon juice until juicy. Whip heavy cream to soft peaks, swirl in the strawberry mixture and remaining diced strawberries, and chill 10 minutes.

title: Classic Vanilla Custard Pudding
instructions: Whisk whole egg, granulated sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan. Slowly whisk in whole milk and unsalted butter, cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 8 to 10 minutes until thick, and chill before serving.

title: Honey Roasted Almond Bark
instructions: Preheat oven to 175 C. Toss almonds and walnuts with honey, maple syrup, and a pinch of salt, spread thin on a parchment-lined sheet, bake 10 to 12 minutes, cool completely, and break into pieces.

title: Cream Cheese Berry Tartlets
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C. Press all-purpose flour, cold unsalted butter, granulated sugar, and salt into tartlet tins and bake 15 minutes until lightly golden. Fill cooled shells with whipped cream cheese and top with blueberries and strawberries.

title: Cocoa Banana Mug Cake
instructions: Mash ripe banana in a bowl and whisk with whole egg, cocoa powder, all-purpose flour, maple syrup, and coconut oil until smooth. Spoon into a greased mug or small ramekin and bake at 180 C for 10 minutes or microwave 90 seconds.

title: Lemon Yogurt Honey Cake
instructions: Preheat oven to 175 C. Whisk greek yogurt, whole egg, honey, granulated sugar, lemon juice, and melted olive oil until smooth. Fold in all-purpose flour and salt, pour into a lined pan, and bake 35 minutes until golden.

title: Peanut Butter Chocolate Clusters
instructions: Melt dark chocolate, peanut butter, and coconut oil gently over low heat until glossy. Stir in chopped peanuts and rolled oats, drop spoonfuls onto parchment paper, and chill until firm.

title: Orange Honey Ricotta-Style Cream
instructions: Beat cottage cheese until smooth, then fold in greek yogurt, honey, and fresh orange segments with a splash of lemon juice. Chill 10 minutes and serve.

title: Double Chocolate Coconut Truffles
instructions: Finely chop dark chocolate and pour hot heavy cream over it; stir until smooth, then mix in cocoa powder and coconut oil. Chill until scoopable, roll into balls, coat in cocoa powder, and refrigerate until firm.

title: Maple Walnut Apple Crisp
instructions: Preheat oven to 185 C. Toss sliced apple with lemon juice and maple syrup in a baking dish. Mix rolled oats, whole wheat flour, brown sugar, chopped walnuts, and melted unsalted butter for the topping, scatter over apples, and bake 35 minutes.

title: Blueberry Lemon Oat Bars
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C. Press a mixture of rolled oats, all-purpose flour, brown sugar, melted unsalted butter, and salt into a square pan and bake 15 minutes. Top with blueberries, granulated sugar, cornstarch, and lemon juice, then bake 20 minutes more.

title: Crispy Honey Fried Bananas
instructions: Slice ripe banana into thick rounds and toss lightly with cornstarch and granulated sugar. Pan-fry in coconut oil over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden and crisp, then drizzle with honey.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Cheesecake Cups
instructions: Beat cream cheese with peanut butter, granulated sugar, and whole milk until smooth. Spoon into cups over a base of crushed rolled oats and melted unsalted butter, top with melted dark chocolate, and chill 1 hour.

title: Citrus Orange Cream Parfait
instructions: Whip heavy cream with granulated sugar until soft peaks form. Layer orange segments, sliced strawberries, and whipped cream in glasses and serve chilled.

title: Almond Butter Chocolate Cookies
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C. Stir together almonds butter-style (using almond nut base), brown sugar, whole egg, cocoa powder, all-purpose flour, and salt until a soft dough forms. Scoop onto a baking sheet and bake 11 to 13 minutes.

title: Three-Cheese Baked Spaghetti
instructions: Preheat oven to 195 C. Boil spaghetti until al dente, then toss with diced tomato, tomato paste, minced garlic, olive oil, and salt. Transfer to a baking dish, top with mozzarella cheese, cheddar cheese, and parmesan cheese, and bake 20 minutes until bubbling.

title: Crispy Chickpea and Spinach Skillet
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion and minced garlic in olive oil for 4 minutes. Add drained chickpeas and salt and pan-fry 8 minutes until lightly crisp, then fold in fresh spinach and lemon juice until wilted.

title: Creamy Mushroom and Spinach Risotto-Style Rice
instructions: Saute sliced mushrooms, diced yellow onion, and minced garlic in unsalted butter and olive oil for 7 minutes. Stir in white rice and salt, gradually add warm water while stirring over medium heat for 25 minutes until creamy, then stir in fresh spinach and parmesan cheese.

title: Black Bean and Sweet Corn Quesadilla Skillet
instructions: Saute diced red bell pepper, yellow onion, and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes, then stir in black beans, sweet corn, and salt. Spoon over a thin flatbread base made from all-purpose flour, whole milk, olive oil, and salt cooked in a skillet, top with cheddar cheese, fold, and toast until melted.

title: Stuffed Baked Zucchini with Cheese and Rice
instructions: Preheat oven to 195 C. Halve zucchini lengthwise and scoop out a little center flesh, then saute the chopped center with yellow onion, garlic, and olive oil for 5 minutes. Mix with cooked white rice, diced tomato, mozzarella cheese, and salt, stuff into zucchini boats, and bake 25 minutes until tender.

title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Skillet
instructions: Dice sweet potato small and saute in olive oil with diced yellow onion, red bell pepper, and minced garlic for 12 minutes until tender. Stir in black beans, sweet corn, diced tomato, and salt and cook 6 minutes until heated through.

title: Vegetable and Egg Fried Quinoa
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat and scramble whole egg until just set. Add diced carrot, green peas, mushrooms, and minced garlic, stir-fry 4 minutes, then toss in cooked quinoa and soy sauce until hot.

title: Garlic Butter Tofu and Broccoli Bowl
instructions: Pan-sear cubed tofu in olive oil and unsalted butter with minced garlic for 6 minutes until golden. Add broccoli florets and a splash of water, cover 4 minutes until tender-crisp, season with soy sauce and salt, and serve over white rice.

title: Cheesy Potato and Spinach Gratin
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 C. Thinly slice potato and layer in a greased baking dish with wilted spinach, minced garlic, and salt. Whisk whole milk, heavy cream, and grated cheddar cheese, pour over the potatoes, and bake 35 to 40 minutes until golden and tender.

title: Tomato and Feta Baked Pasta
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 C. Place whole cherry-style diced tomato, sliced red onion, minced garlic, olive oil, and salt in a baking dish around a block-style portion of feta cheese and bake 20 minutes. Toss with freshly boiled spaghetti and stir until creamy.

title: Lentil and Vegetable Shepherd-Style Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 195 C. Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, green peas, and garlic in olive oil, then stir in cooked lentils, tomato paste, and salt and spoon into a baking dish. Top with mashed potato mixed with unsalted butter and whole milk and bake 20 minutes until lightly browned.

title: Peanut Soy Tofu and Pepper Stir-Fry
instructions: Pan-sear cubed tofu in vegetable oil with sliced red bell pepper, broccoli florets, and minced garlic for 7 minutes. Whisk peanut butter, soy sauce, lemon juice, and warm water into a smooth sauce, toss into the skillet for 2 minutes, and serve over brown rice.

title: Eggplant-Style Zucchini and Tomato Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 195 C. Slice zucchini and tomato into rounds and layer in a baking dish with minced garlic, olive oil, salt, and shredded mozzarella cheese. Bake covered 20 minutes, uncover, and bake 10 minutes more until golden.

title: Kidney Bean and Rice Skillet
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, red bell pepper, sweet corn, and minced garlic in olive oil for 6 minutes. Stir in drained kidney beans, diced tomato, tomato paste, cooked white rice, and salt, and simmer 10 minutes until rich and cohesive.

title: Spinach and Ricotta-Style Cottage Cheese Pasta
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente, reserving a little pasta water. Saute minced garlic in olive oil, fold in fresh spinach until wilted, and toss with hot pasta, drained cottage cheese, grated parmesan cheese, and salt until creamy.

title: Roasted Cauliflower and Chickpea Bowl
instructions: Preheat oven to 210 C. Toss cauliflower florets and rinsed chickpeas with olive oil and salt and roast 22 minutes until browned. Serve over cooked couscous with sliced cucumber, diced tomato, and a lemon juice dressing.

title: Creamy Garlic Parmesan Couscous Skillet
instructions: Saute sliced mushrooms, green peas, and minced garlic in unsalted butter and olive oil for 5 minutes. Stir in couscous, boiling salted water, and heavy cream, cover 5 minutes, fluff, and stir in grated parmesan cheese.

title: Vegetable Frittata with Cheddar and Spinach
instructions: Saute diced red bell pepper, yellow onion, and fresh spinach in olive oil in an oven-safe skillet for 5 minutes. Whisk whole egg, whole milk, grated cheddar cheese, and salt, pour over the vegetables, cook 4 minutes on low, and finish under the broiler or in a 190 C oven for 10 minutes until set.

title: Spiced Lentil and Tomato Rice Pilaf
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Stir in rinsed lentils, brown rice, diced tomato, tomato paste, salt, and water, cover, and simmer 28 minutes until both grains and lentils are tender.

title: Crispy Sesame-Style Soy Garlic Tofu and Noodles
instructions: Boil spaghetti until al dente and drain. Pan-sear cubed tofu in vegetable oil until crisp, add sliced carrot and red bell pepper for 3 minutes, then toss with minced garlic, soy sauce, a touch of maple syrup, and the cooked spaghetti.

title: Cucumber Tomato and Feta Salad
instructions: Dice cucumber and tomato and slice red onion thinly. Toss in a bowl with crumbled feta cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt, then serve chilled.

title: Spinach Strawberry and Almond Salad
instructions: Toss fresh spinach with sliced strawberries, toasted almonds, and crumbled feta cheese. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and honey into a light dressing and toss just before serving.

title: Quinoa Black Bean and Sweet Corn Salad
instructions: Simmer rinsed quinoa in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain, and cool slightly. Toss with rinsed black beans, sweet corn, diced red bell pepper, diced tomato, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Kale Apple and Walnut Salad
instructions: Finely chop kale and massage with olive oil and salt for 2 minutes until tender. Toss with thinly sliced apple, chopped walnuts, and grated cheddar cheese, then drizzle with lemon juice and honey.

title: Egg and Avocado Cobb-Style Salad
instructions: Boil whole egg for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel, and slice. Arrange over fresh spinach with cubed avocado, diced tomato, diced cucumber, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Warm Lentil and Carrot Salad
instructions: Simmer rinsed lentils in salted water for 18 minutes until tender but intact, then drain. Toss warm lentils with finely diced carrot, chopped celery, red onion, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Broccoli Cheddar and Sunflower-Style Peanut Salad
instructions: Blanch small broccoli florets in boiling water for 2 minutes, shock in cold water, and drain well. Toss with diced cheddar cheese, chopped peanuts, diced red onion, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Roasted Sweet Potato and Spinach Salad
instructions: Preheat oven to 205 C. Toss cubed sweet potato with olive oil and salt and roast 22 minutes until tender. Toss warm sweet potato over fresh spinach with crumbled feta cheese, walnuts, and a lemon juice dressing.

title: Tuna White Bean and Cucumber Salad
instructions: Drain tuna in water and flake into a bowl. Fold in rinsed chickpeas, diced cucumber, thinly sliced red onion, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Couscous Herb and Pepper Salad
instructions: Pour boiling salted water over couscous, cover 5 minutes, and fluff with a fork. Toss with diced red bell pepper, diced cucumber, diced tomato, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Chicken Avocado and Tomato Salad
instructions: Pan-sear diced chicken breast seasoned with salt in olive oil for 10 minutes until cooked through and cool slightly. Toss with cubed avocado, diced tomato, diced cucumber, and lemon juice.

title: Shredded Carrot and Cabbage-Style Kale Slaw
instructions: Finely shred carrot and chop kale into thin ribbons. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, honey, and salt into a dressing, toss with the vegetables and chopped almonds, and let sit 5 minutes before serving.

title: Creamy Potato Egg and Dill-Style Herb Salad
instructions: Boil cubed potato in salted water for 12 minutes until tender and drain. Toss warm potatoes with sliced hard-boiled whole egg, diced celery, sour cream, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Orange Spinach and Avocado Salad
instructions: Segment orange and slice avocado. Toss gently with fresh spinach, sliced red onion, olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt.

title: Kidney Bean Corn and Pepper Salad
instructions: Combine rinsed kidney beans, sweet corn, diced red bell pepper, diced cucumber, and finely diced red onion in a bowl. Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and salt and toss evenly.

title: Blueberry Spinach and Feta Salad
instructions: Toss fresh spinach with blueberries, chopped walnuts, and crumbled feta cheese. Drizzle with olive oil, lemon juice, and honey and toss gently.

title: Marinated Tofu and Cucumber Salad
instructions: Cube firm tofu and toss with soy sauce, lemon juice, minced garlic, and vegetable oil. Combine with thinly sliced cucumber, diced red bell pepper, and sweet corn and chill 10 minutes.

title: Salmon Cucumber and Avocado Salad
instructions: Pan-sear salmon fillet seasoned with salt in olive oil for 4 minutes per side until cooked through, then flake into chunks. Serve over spinach with sliced cucumber, cubed avocado, and lemon juice.

title: Brown Rice Mediterranean Bowl Salad
instructions: Simmer brown rice in salted water for 30 minutes until tender and cool slightly. Toss with diced tomato, diced cucumber, red onion, crumbled feta cheese, olive oil, lemon juice, and salt.

title: Apple Celery and Walnut Waldorf-Style Salad
instructions: Dice apple and toss immediately with lemon juice to prevent browning, then mix with chopped celery, chopped walnuts, and greek yogurt with a touch of honey and salt.

title: Garlic Butter Chicken Breast Skillet
instructions: Season chicken breast with salt and sear in olive oil and unsalted butter over medium-high heat for 6 minutes per side until cooked through. Add minced garlic during the last minute and spoon melted pan butter over the meat before resting 5 minutes.

title: Tomato Herb Braised Ground Beef
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, carrot, and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Add ground beef and brown 8 minutes until no pink remains, then stir in diced tomato, tomato paste, and salt and simmer uncovered for 22 minutes until rich.

title: Honey Soy Glazed Pork Loin
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 C. Whisk soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, and olive oil, brush over pork loin seasoned with salt, sear 2 minutes per side in a skillet, and bake 15 minutes until internal temperature reaches 63 C.

title: Crispy Skillet Turkey Breast Cutlets
instructions: Pound turkey breast thin, coat lightly with all-purpose flour and salt, and pan-fry in olive oil and unsalted butter for 4 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice.

title: Sheet Pan Beef Sirloin and Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 210 C. Toss cubed potato and sliced red bell pepper with olive oil and salt and roast 15 minutes. Add sliced beef sirloin to the pan and roast 10 to 12 minutes more until browned and cooked to your liking.

title: Creamy Parmesan Chicken Thighs
instructions: Season chicken thigh with salt and sear in olive oil for 6 minutes per side until browned. Stir in minced garlic, heavy cream, and grated parmesan cheese, simmer gently for 10 minutes until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through, and fold in spinach until wilted.

title: Smoky Bacon and Potato Skillet Hash
instructions: Chop bacon and cook in a large skillet until crisp, then transfer out leaving rendered fat. Saute small cubed potato, diced yellow onion, and red bell pepper in the skillet for 18 minutes until tender and crisp, then return bacon and season with salt.

title: Lemon Butter Pan-Seared Salmon
instructions: Pat salmon fillet dry and season with salt. Sear skin-side down in olive oil over medium-high heat for 5 minutes until crisp, flip, add unsalted butter, minced garlic, and lemon juice, baste 3 minutes until flaky, and serve.

title: Ground Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
instructions: Brown ground beef with minced garlic in vegetable oil for 6 minutes and drain excess grease. Add broccoli florets, sliced carrot, soy sauce, and a splash of water, cover 5 minutes until tender-crisp, and thicken with cornstarch mixed in cold water.

title: Garlic Herb Roasted Pork Loin Roast
instructions: Preheat oven to 195 C. Rub pork loin with olive oil, unsalted butter, minced garlic, and salt, place in a roasting pan with sliced yellow onion and carrot, and roast 35 to 40 minutes until internal temperature hits 63 C. Rest 10 minutes before slicing.

title: Spicy-Style Tomato Pepper Chicken Skillet
instructions: Saute diced yellow onion, red bell pepper, and minced garlic in olive oil for 5 minutes. Stir in diced chicken breast, diced tomato, tomato paste, and salt, simmer 15 minutes until chicken is tender and sauce reduces.

title: Crispy Garlic Butter Shrimp with Zucchini
instructions: Saute sliced zucchini and minced garlic in olive oil for 4 minutes. Push aside, add peeled shrimp seasoned with salt and unsalted butter, cook 2 minutes per side until pink, and finish with lemon juice.

title: Savory Turkey and Spinach Meatballs
instructions: Preheat oven to 200 C. Mix ground-style turkey breast with finely chopped spinach, whole egg, rolled oats, minced garlic, grated parmesan cheese, and salt, shape into meatballs, and bake 18 to 20 minutes until cooked through.

title: Beef Sirloin and Mushroom Skillet
instructions: Slice beef sirloin thinly against the grain and sear in hot olive oil with salt for 3 minutes until browned, then remove. Saute sliced mushrooms, yellow onion, and minced garlic in unsalted butter for 6 minutes, return beef and juices, and toss with lemon juice.

title: Baked Chicken Thighs with Sweet Potatoes
instructions: Preheat oven to 205 C. Toss cubed sweet potato with olive oil and salt in a baking dish, nestle chicken thigh pieces on top, and bake 35 minutes until sweet potatoes are soft and chicken skin is crisp.

title: Tuna and Cheddar Baked Pasta Skillet
instructions: Preheat oven to 190 C. Boil spaghetti until al dente and drain. Mix with drained tuna in water, whole milk, grated cheddar cheese, diced tomato, and salt in a baking dish, top with extra cheddar cheese, and bake 15 minutes until bubbly.

title: Bacon and Cheddar Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: Preheat oven to 195 C. Slice a pocket into chicken breast, fill with cheddar cheese and chopped spinach, wrap or top with bacon, season with salt, and bake 25 to 28 minutes until chicken is cooked through.

title: Soy Garlic Salmon and Rice Bowl
instructions: Pan-sear salmon fillet in vegetable oil with salt for 4 minutes per side until cooked through and flake into chunks. Serve over cooked white rice with steamed broccoli, soy sauce, and a drizzle of honey.

title: Ground Beef and Black Bean Skillet
instructions: Brown ground beef with diced yellow onion, red bell pepper, and minced garlic in olive oil for 7 minutes. Stir in drained black beans, sweet corn, tomato paste, and salt, and simmer 10 minutes until thick.

title: Pork Loin and Apple Skillet Roast
instructions: Season pork loin slices with salt and sear in olive oil and unsalted butter for 3 minutes per side. Add sliced apple, sliced yellow onion, and a splash of water, cover, and simmer 15 minutes until pork is cooked through and apples are tender.

title: Banana Oat Pancakes
instructions: Mash ripe banana and whisk with whole egg, rolled oats, whole milk, maple syrup, and salt until thick. Cook 1/4 cup portions on a skillet greased with unsalted butter over medium heat for 2 minutes per side until golden.

title: Blueberry Greek Yogurt Bowl
instructions: Spoon greek yogurt into bowls and top with blueberries, sliced banana, walnuts, and a drizzle of honey.

title: Cheddar and Red Bell Pepper Omelet
instructions: Saute diced red bell pepper and yellow onion in unsalted butter for 3 minutes until soft. Pour in whisked whole egg with whole milk and salt, scatter grated cheddar cheese, fold when nearly set, and serve.

title: Overnight Chia and Berry Oats
instructions: Stir rolled oats, chia seeds, whole milk, maple syrup, and a pinch of salt together in a bowl or jar. Chill at least 6 hours until thickened, then top with sliced strawberries and blueberries.

title: Avocado and Poached Egg Toast Base
instructions: Pan-bake a thin whole wheat flatbread in a skillet with olive oil until crisp. Mash avocado with lemon juice and salt, spread over the warm flatbread, and top with whole egg cooked to your liking.

title: Potato and Bacon Breakfast Hash
instructions: Crisp chopped bacon in a skillet and set aside. Saute small cubed potato and diced yellow onion in the bacon drippings and olive oil for 14 minutes until golden, then stir in bacon and season with salt.

title: Cottage Cheese Berry Smoothie Bowl
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, whole milk, banana, strawberries, and honey until smooth and thick. Pour into bowls and top with rolled oats and chia seeds.

title: Chocolate Peanut Butter Oatmeal
instructions: Simmer rolled oats in whole milk and salt for 6 minutes until creamy. Stir in cocoa powder, peanut butter, and maple syrup until glossy and top with sliced banana.

title: Mushroom and Mozzarella Scramble
instructions: Saute sliced mushrooms and fresh spinach in unsalted butter for 4 minutes until tender. Whisk whole egg with a splash of whole milk and salt, pour in, stir gently, and fold in mozzarella cheese until melted.

title: Apple Cinnamon Buckwheat-Style Oat Crepes
instructions: Blend rolled oats, whole egg, whole milk, honey, and salt into a smooth batter. Pour thin crepes into a skillet with unsalted butter, cook 1 to 2 minutes per side, and fill with sauteed sliced apple.

title: Sweet Potato and Egg Breakfast Skillet
instructions: Dice sweet potato small and saute in olive oil with diced yellow onion and salt for 12 minutes until tender. Make two wells, crack whole egg into each, cover 5 minutes until whites set, and finish with avocado.

title: Honey Almond Yogurt and Apple Bowl
instructions: Toss diced apple with lemon juice, then layer with greek yogurt, chopped almonds, and rolled oats. Drizzle with honey and serve.

title: Cream Cheese and Strawberry French-Style Toast
instructions: Pan-toast thick whole wheat slices in unsalted butter until golden. Spread with whipped cream cheese and honey and top with sliced strawberries.

title: Savory Black Bean and Egg Breakfast Bowl
instructions: Warm rinsed black beans and diced tomato in olive oil with salt for 5 minutes. Top with fried or scrambled whole egg, cubed avocado, and crumbled feta cheese.

title: Maple Walnut Baked Oats Cup
instructions: Preheat oven to 180 C. Mix rolled oats, whole egg, skim milk, maple syrup, chopped walnuts, and salt, spoon into ramekins, and bake 20 minutes until set and golden.

title: Smoked-Style Bacon and Cheddar Egg Muffin Bake
instructions: Preheat oven to 185 C. Whisk whole egg, egg white, whole milk, grated cheddar cheese, diced red bell pepper, and salt, pour into a greased muffin tin over chopped bacon, and bake 18 minutes until set.

title: Orange Chia and Yogurt Parfait
instructions: Stir chia seeds and honey into greek yogurt and let sit 5 minutes. Layer with orange segments and blueberries in glasses and serve chilled.

title: Crispy Peanut Banana Crepes
instructions: Whisk all-purpose flour, whole egg, whole milk, granulated sugar, and salt into a thin batter. Cook in coconut oil over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes per side, fill with sliced banana and peanut butter, and fold.

title: Spinach and Cottage Cheese Savory Pancakes
instructions: Blend cottage cheese, whole egg, whole wheat flour, chopped spinach, and salt into a thick batter. Spoon onto a skillet with olive oil and cook over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes per side until golden.

title: Warm Berry and Coconut Oil Oats
instructions: Simmer rolled oats in whole milk and salt for 6 minutes until creamy. Stir in coconut oil and maple syrup, then top with blueberries and strawberries.
